Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Gnash 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Melee 1 x One creature or object
Story.Ability_Body: Whenever a non-minion ally within 7 squares of the gnasher is reduced to 0 Stamina, the gnasher moves up to their speed and can make a melee free strike.

Figure.alt: þÿA gnoll in studded leather armor twists, swinging a spiked ball-and-chain flail across their body The purple gnoll has blonde hair with dark spots, a bloody scar over their left eye, and a gold earring. They wear a red sash under their studded leather pauldrons and breastplate, a thick fur wrap under a leather belt with shortsword and dagger, orange, tartan pants, and gold jewelry. Their left arm is up, across their body, ready to whip the flail downward in an attack, and the right is clawed behind them.

Story.Ability_Body: Trigger An enemy within 5 squares is reduced to 0 Stamina.
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The gnasher moves up to their speed and can use their signa - ture ability.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Flurry of Fangs 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Melee 1 x Three creatures or objects

Story.Ability_Body: Trigger The gnasher reduces a creature to 0 Stamina.
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The gnasher consumes part of the target’s body. The gnasher can spend a Recovery, and each enemy within 5 squares of the gnasher who has i<v is frightened (save ends).

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Stabbity Stab 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Melee 1 x One creature or object
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The target can’t make opportunity attacks until the end of the guide’s turn.
Story.Ability_Body: The guide doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks by moving.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Weaving Knives 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Melee 1 x One creature or object
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The guide shifts up to their speed before and after the strike.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Sneak and Stab 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Abiilty_Power_Roll: é 12 damage; the guide and their mentor can each move up to their speed
í 16 damage; the guide and their mentor can each move up to their speed, then attempt to hide
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: If the guide is hidden from the target, this ability has a double edge.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: p Poison Blade 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The guide applies poison to their weapon. The next time the guide obtains a tier 2 or tier 3 outcome on a weapon strike, the strike deals an extra 10 poison damage, and if the target has m<v , they are weakened (save ends). If the guide is adjacent to their men - tor when they use Poison Blade, they apply poison to the mentor’s weapon in the same way.

Figure.alt:
þÿA goblin carries a chest full of coins over their shoulder.
The long-haired, long-eared, green-skinned goblin is in profile as they carry the steel-banded treasure chest over one shoulder. Bags have been strapped to their back, alongside a polished brass short sword. Gold coins fall from the chest and from a hole in the bag.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: r Fire Curse 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Ranged 10 x One creature or object
Story.Abiilty_Power_Roll: í 12 fire damage; a<s the target is burning (save ends)
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: A burning creature takes 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of their turns. A burning object takes 1d6 fire damage at the end of each round.

Effect: Until the end of the flameslinger’s next turn, the target has fire weakness equal to the flameslinger’s level. If the target is the flameslinger’s mentor, they instead have fire immunity equal to the flameslinger’s level.
Story.Ability_Body: When the flameslinger is reduced to 0 Stamina, they spray burn - ing blood. Each creature adjacent to the flameslinger takes 3 fire damage.

Figure.alt: þÿA hobgoblin holding a flame-tipped blade coalesces out of smoke, attacking an unsuspecting guard A devilish, grinning, red-skinned hobgoblin forms out of black smoke pouring in through a barred window. They wear a hood with spikes and two long, sharp horns, and black plate armor. They carry a shield and a gleaming shortsword trailing red flames from its blade. They drop down from behind onto a light-skinned, helmed human guard in plate armor holding a spear and facing us.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: a Unholy Attraction 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e 3 cube within 10 x Each enemy in the area
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: A target who is pulled adjacent to the flameslinger and who has p<v is knocked prone.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: b Fire Spiral 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e 3 Burst x Each enemy in the area
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: If the flameslinger’s mentor is within 10 squares of the flameslinger, the mentor can be the source of the burst instead of the flameslinger.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Chop 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Melee 1 x One creature or object
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: If the warrior is adjacent to their mentor, this ability gains an edge.
Story.Ability_Body: The warrior ignores concealment if it’s granted by a supernatural effect.

Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Melee 1 x The warrior’s mentor
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Trigger: The warrior’s mentor is targeted by a strike while within distance.
Effect: The warrior and the mentor switch places. The warrior is the strike’s new target and the strike has a double bane.

Figure.alt:
þÿA masculine human in plate armor stands with sword drawn and shield ready
The armored man wears a blue patterned kilt and thick, trailing cloak. His armor is trimmed with gold, and polished to a bright shine. His shield features a large, golden face in the center of a sun, upraised from the center. The man wears a serious expression, light eyes drawn and brow furrowed, his lips forming a line under a waxed mustache.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Defensive Fighting 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: Until the start of the warrior’s next turn, ability rolls against the warrior or any ally adjacent to the warrior have a double bane.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: b Whirlwind of Steel 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Burst 1 x Each enemy in the area

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Gladius 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Melee 1 x One creature or object
Story.Ability_Body: While the shieldbearer is adjacent to their mentor, both have a +1 bonus to stability, have cover, and grant cover to allies.

Figure.alt: þÿA kobold with a shortsword and dragonscale tower shield roars and takes a defensive stance A red-and-blue kobold with blue frills behind their face, at their elbows, and down their tail opens their toothy mouth in a yell. They wear a brass helm and bracers, a bronze scale breastplate, and a black leather skirt. They lunge backward, holding a shortsword and a brown dragonscale shield with a red skull design painted on it at the ready. Behind them, more kobolds charge into combat.

Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Ranged 5 x The shieldbearer’s mentor
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Trigger: The mentor takes damage from a strike while within distance.

Effect: The shieldbearer blocks the strike (if adjacent to the mentor) or throws their shield into the mentor’s space. The triggering strike’s damage is halved and the potency of any potency effects is reduced by 1. If the shieldbearer threw their shield, it bounces back to their hand.

Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Melee 1 x The shieldbearer’s mentor
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The shieldbearer straps their shield on their back and climbs onto their mentor’s back, entering the mentor’s space. While the shieldbearer is on their mentor’s back, each of them gains 10 temporary Stamina and can use Shield Block as a triggered action targeting an ally instead of the shieldbearer’s mentor. Additionally, the shieldbearer moves with the mentor, and they can’t use main actions, maneuvers, or move actions except to end this effect as a maneuver. The effect also ends if the shieldbearer is force moved away from their mentor or knocked prone. If the shieldbearer is still in their mentor’s space when the effect ends, they move into an adjacent unoccupied space of their choice.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Let’s Go Sledding 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: Charge, Melee, Strike, Weapon Main action
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: If this ability is used as part of the Charge main action, the shieldbearer gains 2 surges that can be used immediately.

Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Melee 1 x The triggering creature
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Trigger: The gorer damages a creature within distance using Gore.
Effect: The target is pushed up to 3 squares. If the target has stability 0, they are also knocked prone.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Gore 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: Charge, Melee, Strike, Weapon Main action
e Melee 1 x One creature or object
e Ranged 6 x The triggering creature
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Trigger: A creature within distance deals damage to the gorer.
Effect: The gorer uses the Charge main action and Gore against the target.
Story.Ability_Body: The gorer can’t obtain less than a tier 2 outcome when making tests to navigate, search, or seek.

Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The gorer gains 3 surges, and until the start of the gorer’s next turn, strikes made against them and their mentor take a bane.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: b Horn Rake 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e 1 burst x Each enemy in the area
Story.Abiilty_Power_Roll: 3 21 damage; m<s prone and can’t stand (save ends).

Figure.alt: þÿA waist-up portrait of a cross-armed, staff-wielding minotaur wearing intricately wrapped and tasseled green-and-yellow garb This portrait immediately gives the impression of ceremonial garb and is intensely, vibrantly in kelly greens and, predominantly, mustard yellows and golds, which also back the pink-faced, dark-brown-furred minotaur with gold-beaded locs and a pierced ear. They have wide, white-wrapped horns with gold bands and loosely draped in golden cord. Close to their head, green, gold-trimmed-and-tasseled strips of fabric are wrapped so they narrow until the final wraps drape like runed banners on either side of their face. Two pieces of tasseled, red-beaded fabric cross the minotaur's face, meeting with a red gem in a gold setting betweeen their eyes and above their pierced nose. They wear high-collared green robes with golden trim leaving their scarred, muscular arms bare, one wrapped in golden fabric from under the shoulder to the hand, the other, crossed beneath, gripping a green-wrapoped, tasseled stick with a gold, red-gemmed handle with two gold links at the end.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: v Notched Axe 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: Charge, Melee, Ranged, Strike, Weapon Main action
e Melee 1 or ranged 5 x One creature or object
Story.Ability_Body: If the charger is reduced to 0 Stamina, they can make a free strike before dying. If the target of the free strike is reduced to 0 Stamina, the charger is reduced to 1 Stamina instead.

Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: Until the start of the charger’s next turn, the charger and their mentor each have temporary Stamina equal to their Recovery value and a +2 bonus to speed, and they each gain an edge on reactive tests.

Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Self; See below x Self
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The charger moves in a straight line up to their speed. During this move, they ignore enemy free strikes, and they can make a me - lee free strike against any creature they move adjacent to.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: b Vein Burst 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e 2 burst x Each enemy in the area
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The charger takes psychic damage equal to the number of enemies affected. This damage can’t be reducetd in any way.

Figure.alt: þÿAn orc charges with an upraised tower shield raised in front of them This masculine orc rushes forward, their leg upraised and arm back, moving quickly so that their hair blows behind them in their charge. Red veins light with energy from their upraised arm, down their side and torso, tracing like lightning across their green body. The spiked tower shield they hold forward is made of flowing, overlapping pieces with square spikes placed at odd intervals. The orc wears padded leggings and steel bracers, boots, and a single leather-strapped pauldron.

þÿA radenwight leans casually, arms crossed, against a wrought-iron-tipped, upward-curved stone wall A lantern in the lower-left corner illuminates the light-grey-furred radenwight from beneath. They wear a grey vest over a white shirt and green, striped pants, their feet bare and fur-tipped tail draping on the ground. Across their chest, they have a bandolier with three throwing knives, and they wear a sword and a coil of rope at their hip. They lean against the wall next to an out-of-frame window with a wrought-iron pane, and between the iron spikes of the wall behind them are large white sheets hanging fro a laundry line, obscuring the city.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: v Dagger’s Bite 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: Melee, Ranged, Strike, Weapon Main action
e Melee 1 or ranged 5 x One creature or object
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Trigger: An ally deals damage to the target.
Effect: The sidekick makes a free strike against the target.

Effect: If the sidekick’s mentor moves adjacent to the sidekick at any point during the mentor’s turn, the mentor gains a +1 bonus to speed and can automatically climb at full speed while moving until the end of their turn.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: a Bug Bag 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e 3 cube within 3 x Each creature in the area
Story.Abiilty_Power_Roll: á 6 poison damage; m<w weakened (save ends)
é 9 poison damage; m<v weakened (save ends)
í 13 poison damage; m<s weakened (save ends)

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: r Triumphant Squeak 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Ranged 10 x Self and each ally
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: Each target can spend a Recovery, and ends the dazed, fright - ened, and weakened conditions on themself.

Story.Stat_Retainer_Name: Time Raider Mind Healer Level 3 Support Retainer

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: r Laser Lancet 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Ranged 3 x One creature or object
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: If the mind healer targets an ally, the ability deals no damage. Additionally, the target can end one effect on them that can be ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn.
Story.Ability_Body: The mind healer doesn’t take a bane on strikes against creatures with concealment.

Figure.alt: þÿA red-caped time raider triumphantly raises their upper arms, one wielding a golden scimitar, while one of their lower aims a blaster The grinning, medium-skinned, lean time raider has a red mohawk and purple crystals erupting from their upper left arm. They wear a tall-collared red-and-gold cloak and one leopard-print pauldron with a matching loincloth, a second sword with a swirling gold hilt at their hip, and gold and ruby jewelry on their arms, wrists, and long-nailed fingers. On their scarred bare chest is a black, gold, and purple-crystal harness matching their claw-toed pirate boots and the blaster in their lower right hand.

Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The target can spend 1 Recovery, and has their speed doubled until the end of their next turn.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: r Mind Whelm 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
b Psychic Short Circuit 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e 2 burst x Each enemy in the area
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: If the mind healer is dazed, frightened, or taunted, they can end one of those conditions and impose the same condition on one enemy in the area. Additionally, they can do the same for their men - tor if the mentor is in the area and is dazed, frightened, or taunted.
Effect: The mercenary must be winded to use this ability. The merce - nary uses Big Bite against each target.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Big Bite 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: Charge, Melee, Strike, Weapon Main action
e Melee 1 x One creature or object
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The mercenary regains Stamina equal to half the damage dealt.
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e 3 burst x Each enemy in the area
Story.Ability_Body: The mercenary dies only if they are reduced to 0 Stamina by acid or fire damage, if they end their turn with 0 Stamina, or if they take acid or fire damage while at 0 Stamina.

Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Trigger: An ability deals acid or fire damage to the mercenary.
Effect: The mercenary moves up to their speed. If this movement takes them beyond the distance of the triggering ability, the ability has no effect on them.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Lurching Swipe 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Melee 1 x One creature or object
Story.Ability_Body: The first time in an encounter that the servitor is reduced to 0 Stamina by damage that isn’t fire damage or holy damage and their body isn’t destroyed, they regain half their Stamina maxi - mum and fall prone.

Figure.alt: þÿA crowned, armored skeleton wields a staff topped with a glowing crystal Glowing eyes peer from within a grinning skull in a jagged crown and tattered mantling. The skeleton wears leather-and-bronze pauldrons with gold coins, gauntlets, and a tattered, gold-runed, dark skirt with a coin-latticed belt. A tattered cloak blows behind them. They step toward us with a bangled foot. Their staff is topped with gem-setting-like spikes around a floating yellow stone.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Grab and Bite 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
r Death to Death 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: Before making the strike, the servitor can teleport up to 10 squares to a space containing a dead creature, then burst out of the creature’s body.

Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e 2 burst x Each enemy in the area
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Trigger: The servitor is reduced to 0 Stamina.
Effect: The servitor explodes.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: r Chill of Death 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Ranged 10 x One creature or object
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: While adjacent to their mentor, the unquiet spirit enters the mentor’s space. A spirit who enters their mentor’s space this way moves with the mentor, can’t be sensed, and can’t affect or be affected by other creatures or objects. They can’t take main actions, maneuvers, or move actions, except to use this ability to leave their mentor’s space and appear in an adjacent space.
Story.Ability_Body: The unquiet spirit can move through creatures and objects at their usual speed, but can’t end their turn inside a creature or object. The first time in a round that the spirit moves through a creature other than their mentor, that creature takes 2 corruption damage.

Figure.alt: þÿA spectral blue rotting figure with wild hair and enormous, clawed hands floats above a graveyard Floating on wisps instead of feet, the electric-blue, shadowy skin of the wraith seems solid in some places, but vein-like and translucent in others. Wild blue hair fading from almost black to light neon aqua swirls around their head. Their eyes glow white and an open jaw reveals large yellow teeth. Bone-thin arms stretch from a tattered brown shawl with clawed hands twice the size of their head.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: r Enervating Curse 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Abiilty_Power_Roll: 1 6 corruption damage; the target has 1 level of drain
2 10 corruption damage; the target has 2 levels of drain
3 14 corruption damage; the target has 3 levels of drain
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The next creature to make a strike against the target gains 1 surge for each level of drain, which must be used on that strike.

Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e 3 cube within 1 x Each enemy in the area

Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: If the target has p<s , they are phased until the end of their next turn. A phased target gains the unquiet spirit’s Corruptive Phasing trait and can fly. They are visible but can’t affect or be affect - ed by other creatures or objects. A willing creature not subject to the ability’s potency can choose to automatically be affected.

Figure.alt: þÿA blood-drenched vampire in courtly clothes stands on a bloody staircase holding a longsword In front of a deep red sky, a light-skinned, dark-haired vampire, their face, clothes, and hands covered in blood, stands on a dripping, bloody stone staircase. They wear a dark cloak, deep green doublet, and leather pauldrons and gauntlets, all detailed with gold designs. In their right hand, they hold bloody longsword topped with a large ruby behind their body, angled slightly upward.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Flashing Fangs 2d10 + highest characteristic Signature Ability
Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e Melee 1 x One creature or object
Story.Abiilty_Power_Roll: 3 5 damage, 6 corruption damage; m<s bleeding (save ends)
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: The vampire rebel gains temporary Stamina equal to any corruption damage dealt.

Effect: The vampire rebel changes their form into a bat. In bat form, their size is 1T and they can fly. The vampire rebel then shifts up to their speed, then regains their true form. If they can’t fit in their cur - rent space when they return to their true form, they take 10 damage and are pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.
Story.Ability_Body: The vampire rebel has speed 10 while any creature within 10 squares of them is bleeding. If the vampire rebel is able to deal damage to a bleeding creature on their turn and does not do so, they take 5 corruption damage at the end of their turn.

Story.Stat_Block_Ability_Header: m Blood Surge 2d10 + highest characteristic Encounter
Story.Ability_Data_Leading_Colon: Effect: Before the strike, the vampire rebel shifts up to their speed. If the vampire rebel has temporary Stamina, they can expend it, dealing an extra 2 corruption damage for each point of temporary Stamina expended this way.

Story.Ability_Range__Type__Action_: e 3 cube within 1 x Each enemy in the area

Figure.alt: þÿA half dozen goblins chaotically attack an armored adventurer desperately trying to fight them off A frenzied adventurer wearing plate mail and wielding a sword is covered in goblins attacking in every direction. The chaotic green tangle of limbs and teeth has loincloth-wearing goblins with crude shortswords and wooden bucklers tugging on the adventurer's shield, biting their leg, trying not to get hit in the face, clinging to their neck and pulling off their helm, and being kicked in the rump.
